slides.title: Pondy, on foot
slides.sub: 5 things to do near our house

slides.title: Leave the car keys
slides.sub: White Town is small, flat and best seen slowly. Rock Beach is two minutes from our door.

slides.title: Sunrise on Rock Beach
slides.sub: The coast faces east, so the sun comes up over the sea. Get to the promenade early.

slides.title: The French Quarter lanes
slides.sub: Yellow walls, bougainvillea and quiet streets. Walk them before the day gets hot.

slides.title: Sri Aurobindo Ashram
slides.sub: A few calm minutes in the middle of town.

slides.title: Manakula Vinayagar Temple
slides.sub: One of Pondy's best-known temples, a short walk into the centre.

slides.title: Back on the promenade
slides.sub: Past the Gandhi statue and the old lighthouse, with the sea breeze coming in.

slides.title: Save this for Pondy
slides.sub: So the list is there when you land.

posts.caption:
Leave the car keys at home in Pondy.

From our house in White Town, Rock Beach is a two-minute walk. Most of what you came for is easier on foot.

Sunrise on the promenade. The yellow French Quarter lanes. A quiet stop at Sri Aurobindo Ashram, then Manakula Vinayagar Temple. And in the evening, back along the sea past the Gandhi statue and the old lighthouse.

Save this for your Pondy trip.

Stay with us: thecoastalcalm.com or call +91 88704 67560.
